title: Augmented strict reduction tower of ordinary pullback
statement:
Let $g:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes. Use the Noetherian adic datum $A,I,P_n=A/I^n$, small pro-etale sites, coefficient sheaves $B_W=A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$, and strict tower categories of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], for $W=T,T'$. Put $R_W=\underline A_W$, $S_{n,W}=\underline{P_n}_W=(P_n)_W$, and write $\operatorname{Res}_W:D(B_W)\to D(R_W)$ for exact restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use the canonical finite coefficient comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] and the derived module pullbacks of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback].

For any $K\in D(B_T)$, without a completeness hypothesis, put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{B_T}S_{n,T}$ and $N=Lg^*_{R}\operatorname{Res}_T K$. Let $H_\bullet=Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}K_\bullet$, a complex of strict $B_{T'}$-towers whose finite coefficient evaluations are $H_n=Lg_n^*K_n$. Let $\mathcal R(N)_n=N\otimes^L_{R_{T'}}S_{n,T'}$ denote the strict reduction tower computed on one flat-term K-flat representative [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum, def-pc-kflat-complex].

There is a canonical natural isomorphism $\tau:\mathcal R(N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{T'}H_\bullet$ in the derived category of strict $R_{T'}$-towers, induced by an isomorphism of strict diagrams on compatible K-flat models. Its finite coefficient evaluation is the composite $\tau_n$ of the canonical pullback/tensor comparison with $Lg_n^*$ of the finite constant-to-completed scalar comparison. It commutes with every quotient transition and carries the quotient augmentation from the constant tower on $N$ to the restriction of the pulled-back quotient augmentation, precomposed with the ordinary constant-to-completed pullback comparison.

For $\widehat N=R\lim\mathcal R(N)$, using total right derived inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], it induces an isomorphism $\rho:\operatorname{Res}_{T'}(R\lim H_\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat N$. If $p_n^H,p_n$ are the respective evaluations, then $\operatorname{Res}(p_n^H)=\tau_n p_n\rho$. Under $\rho$ the pulled-back augmentation gives the quotient-completion unit $\eta:N\to\widehat N$, and $p_n\eta=u_n$, the finite scalar-extension unit. All comparisons are natural in $K$.
